data.name: Principal Product Manager
data.jobDescription:
Overview
The PowerPoint Product Group builds an app that millions of people open every day to create, collaborate and present their ideas to their audiences. We are in the middle of the biggest transformation in our history: rebuilding PowerPoint and storytelling for the AI and agentic era to empower everyone to drive real change. 
 
We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to own a strategic portfolio within the PowerPoint product. You will decide what gets built and why, define what quality means for your area, and stay accountable for whether customers love what ships. This is a product builder’s job, with you being directly involved in creating prototypes, driving customer conversations, evaluating what we are planning to ship, and delivering the best experience to our users.
 
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.


Responsibilities
  • Set the strategy for your area and make the calls on scope and sequencing. You will write the vision and plans and make sure everyone building against them understands what they are and why they matter. 
  • Build a first-hand understanding of who you are building for and what is genuinely hard in their day. You will stay close to customer conversations, feedback, and telemetry every week, and be able to state the problem you are solving in plain language. Part of the craft is telling the difference between a problem that is interesting and one urgent enough that someone will change how they work.
  • Turn product vision into a roadmap and product requirements. You will write the framing memos and specifications that let the team move fast, prioritize the backlog, and adapt as evidence arrives.
  • Frame a hypothesis before the work starts, instrument what ships, and let the result change the plan. Your area should get measurably better week over week, and you should be able to say by how much. 
  • You will design the evaluation approach that reflects what the product should do for a customer, covering helpfulness, accuracy, safety, and voice, and partner with engineering and data & applied sciences to run it and act on what it shows.
  • Use AI in your own practice. Work with agents and prototype your ideas quickly to validate some of your assumptions and run experiments.
  • Bring marketing, sales, and support in at the start of the cycle instead of the end. Know what competitors have shipped and how it landed, and be able to tell the one story about this product that only we can tell. 


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product management or software development. 
    • OR equivalent experience. 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 12+ years experience in product management or software development. 
    • OR equivalent experience. 
  • A track record of products you personally shipped, told through the customer outcomes they produced. 
  • Experience owning a product area’s direction, including the decisions you made and what you learned from them. 
  • Demonstrated product judgment — what’s important in a product experience and why — and product system thinking — how a product experience is realized across its surfaces and platforms. 
  • Fluency with product data, including user funnels, retention, and experimentation, and the ability to work in it directly. 
  • Working knowledge of modern AI systems, including how quality gets evaluated and where these systems fail. 
  • Prototyping ability, in design tools or in code, used to make ideas concrete early. 
  • Direct work with enterprise customers on adoption, feedback, and evaluation datasets.

data.jobDescription:
Overview

We build Microsoft Purview capabilities that help customers protect data, govern AI, investigate security risks, and drive secure AI adoption.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.




Responsibilities
  • Define and drive product strategy, roadmap priorities, and investment decisions aligned with customer needs, business objectives, and organizational goals.
  • Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives by aligning engineering and partner teams around clear priorities, outcomes, dependencies, and execution plans. 
  • Represent the voice of the customer by leveraging customer feedback, market insights, competitive analysis, and data to inform product direction and prioritization.
  • Establish success metrics, monitor product and business outcomes, and drive data-informed decisions to maximize customer and organizational impact.
  • Influence across teams and leadership through clear communication, sound judgment, and operational excellence, while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.



Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree AND 5+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development OR equivalent experience. 

Preferrered Qualification:

  • Customer Impact First: Deliver measurable customer value and improve customer satisfaction through every release and engagement. 
  • *AI & Security Leadership: Advance Microsoft Security priorities by enabling secure AI adoption, strong data governance, and risk reduction.
  • *Execution Excellence: Drive clarity, accountability, and predictable delivery with high operational rigor.
  • *One Microsoft Collaboration: Partner effectively across engineering, design, GTM, support, and field teams to achieve shared outcomes.


    Other Requirements:
  • Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check:
    - This position will be required to pass the Microsoft background and Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

title: Senior Product Manager | Microsoft Careers

data.name: Principal Product Manager
data.jobDescription:
Overview

Search Platform is the retrieval and grounding foundation for Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents. Our shared services turn Microsoft 365 knowledge into trusted, permission-aware evidence through indexing, retrieval and ranking, and grounding. Product teams across Microsoft consume them through Microsoft Graph and Work IQ, and relevance teams ship quality on top of them. Every Copilot answer, search result, and agent action is only as good as the evidence behind it, so our job is to make every quality gain land faster, cheaper, and everywhere, and to prove it with data everyone trusts. 

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager on the Enterprise Search and Grounding Platform team to drive strategy and execution to deliver Copilot and Agents quality gains.  

This position is based in Redmond, Washington and requires the employee be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

The strategy 

  • Define the vision, multi-year roadmap, and success metrics for the Developer Experience pillar, anchored on the Search Platform north star: one trusted platform, tuned by scenario, with recall-forward, low-latency retrieval for agents. 

  • Own product definition for the developer-facing API surface, including the next major version of our core retrieval API and the Work IQ and Retrieval API integration patterns, with a bias toward stable, scenario-agnostic contracts that outlive any single experience. 

  • Decide what the platform should offer as a shared capability and what stays with individual agent teams, and drive the consolidation of bespoke integrations onto supported patterns. 

Make the platform easy to build on 

  • Design the onboarding path for a new agent team, from first call to production: reference integrations, documentation, samples, and self-serve tooling that remove the need for a bespoke engagement. 

  • Treat debuggability as a product requirement. Specify the observability, tracing, and diagnostics developers need to understand why a query returned what it did and to fix issues without escalating to the platform team. 

  • Translate agent needs into platform requirements for recall, latency budgets, and evidence formats, working with the Quality Improvements and Frontier Platform Innovation pillars so that recall-forward retrieval tuned for agents ships as part of the core platform. 

Lead across the organization 

  • Author crisp specs, requirements documents, and program plans; drive execution across multiple engineering teams and owners; and communicate status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to leadership. 

  • Represent Search Platform developer experience with senior stakeholders across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Graph, Work IQ, and partner organizations, landing decisions and aligning roadmaps. 

  • Raise the bar for platform product management on the team by mentoring PMs and modeling data-driven, customer-obsessed decision making. 



Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development 
    • OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements:
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
 
Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Significant experience shipping developer-facing platforms, APIs, or SDKs consumed by other engineering teams, including ownership of API design, versioning, and deprecation decisions. 
  • Demonstrated ability to define a platform strategy and land it across organizational boundaries, influencing senior engineering and product leaders without direct authority. 
  • Technical depth: comfortable with distributed systems and the trade-offs among latency, throughput, and cost, and able to engage credibly with senior engineers in design reviews. 
  • Track record of turning customer and developer feedback into prioritized roadmaps and measurable outcomes. 
  • Communicate with clear, narratives and actionable specifications to executive-level audience.
  • Experience with search, information retrieval, retrieval-augmented generation, grounding, or LLM-based agent platforms. 
  • Experience serving both first-party and third-party developers, including documentation, onboarding, and developer support models. 
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Graph, or other enterprise data platforms with permission-aware access. 
  • Experience defining observability and diagnostics as a product surface, or operating platform scorecards and metrics. 
  • Prior experience as a software engineer.

title: Principal Product Manager | Microsoft Careers

data.name: Principal Product Manager- Copilot
data.jobDescription:
Overview

The Copilot Platform team is building the foundational capabilities that power the next generation of AI experiences across Microsoft 365 Copilot. Our mission is to create a secure, reliable, and scalable platform that enables teams across Microsoft to rapidly build and deliver high-quality Copilot experiences for customers.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the vision and strategy for Agentic Engineering across Microsoft 365 Copilot and BizChat.

AI is fundamentally changing how software is built and operated. Our ambition is to go beyond using AI to make individual engineering tasks faster. We want to reimagine the software development lifecycle (SDLC) around collaboration between engineers and AI agents.

In this role, you will define the strategy for how agentic capabilities transform the engineering lifecycle, from planning and design through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production operations. You will partner closely with engineering and product leaders to turn this vision into scalable platforms, workflows, and practices that improve engineering velocity, quality, reliability, and developer experience.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

  • Define the vision and strategy for Agentic Engineering across the end-to-end software development lifecycle.

  • Identify the highest-value opportunities for AI agents to improve how engineers design, build, test, deploy, monitor, and operate software.

  • Develop a product strategy and roadmap for moving from AI-assisted development toward increasingly agent-native engineering workflows.

  • Partner with engineering teams to create reusable agentic capabilities, platforms, and patterns that can scale across a large engineering organization.

  • Establish success metrics that measure improvements in engineering productivity, quality, reliability, cycle time, and developer experience.

  • Drive adoption of new agentic engineering practices and help teams evolve the way they build and operate software.

  • Bring together related investments across teams into a cohesive strategy while enabling teams to innovate within their domains.

  • Influence senior product and engineering leaders and drive alignment across organizational boundaries.

  • Stay at the forefront of advances in AI agents and software engineering and translate emerging capabilities into meaningful engineering transformation.



Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
    • OR equivalent experience. 

Other Requirements:
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
 
Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in product management, software engineering, technical program management, or equivalent roles delivering technically complex products or platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to define product vision and strategy in ambiguous and rapidly evolving areas.
  • Solid understanding of software development practices, developer workflows, and the software development lifecycle.
  • Experience working with AI, developer platforms, engineering systems, or large-scale cloud services.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex initiatives across multiple engineering teams and organizational boundaries.
  • Solid analytical skills with experience defining measurable product and business outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence both technical teams and senior leaders.
  • Experience with generative AI, AI agents, AI-powered developer tools, or developer productivity platforms.
  • Experience building platforms, tools, or workflows used by large engineering organizations.
  • Understanding of AI evaluation, agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop systems, or autonomous workflows.
  • Experience with large-scale distributed systems, DevOps, reliability, or production engineering.

#CAP #Copilot

There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $188,000 - $304,200 per year.

Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. data.name: Principal Product Manager
data.jobDescription:
Overview

The Microsoft 365 Core Platform team is hiring a Principal Product Manager for its Fleet & Capacity team, the group that puts the right infrastructure in the right places at the right time for every Microsoft 365 workload. The team plans, delivers, and operates the fleet behind Microsoft 365, and it directs billions of dollars in capacity investment each year. This is a broad role for a builder who wants to move across the charter and take on the biggest open problems rather than hold a single fixed area. 

The work spans demand forecasting, capacity investment planning, platform and hardware strategy, supply and demand balancing, capacity delivery, live fleet operations, and decommissioning. AI growth is reshaping all of it. Demand is larger and less predictable than it has ever been, hardware choices carry more weight, and the cost of getting capacity wrong scales with the fleet. You will help the team decide where to invest, when to build, what to run it on, and how to keep the fleet healthy and efficient as it grows. 

This is an AI-first product management role. You will use agents, automation, and AI-driven analysis alongside standard PM tools to read telemetry, model tradeoffs, prototype solutions, and reach decisions faster. You will translate hard technical and financial tradeoffs into terms leaders can act on, and you will help move the team toward AI-forward ways of working, including evaluation sets and agent-based workflows built into how the work gets done. 

You will partner closely with engineering leaders, architects, data scientists, finance, and supply chain across Microsoft. The role carries broad visibility and influence, and it depends on strong product sense, technical depth, data fluency, and clear judgment under uncertainty. 

This position is based in Redmond, Washington and requires the employee be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 



Responsibilities

  • Shape the strategy for the capacity and fleet work that matters most across Microsoft 365, and turn that direction into a roadmap teams can execute. 

  • Take on high-impact problems across the charter, including capacity planning, supply and demand balancing, fleet health, platform transitions, and decommissioning, and drive them to a result. 

  • Use AI-driven analysis of demand signals, telemetry, and operational data to forecast more accurately, catch capacity and reliability issues early, and fix them at the root. 

  • Use agents, automation, and AI Ops to analyze data, coordinate work, and act on what you learn. 

  • Model capacity and hardware tradeoffs with AI prototyping and scenario testing before committing investment, paired with solid product, engineering, and financial judgment. 

  • Weigh cost, performance, and reliability against each other, and prioritize multi-year capacity investments with partners across engineering, finance, and supply chain. 

  • Advance platform and hardware transition strategy, and help the fleet run more efficiently as workloads grow. 

  • Set success metrics, OKRs (Objectives and Key Results), and KPIs (key performance indicators), and shape investment priorities with leadership. 

  • Explain complex technical and financial tradeoffs to executives in a way that leads to decisions. 

  • Mentor other product managers and move the team toward better, AI-forward ways of working. 



Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
    • OR equivalent experience.

 

Other Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's Degree AND 12+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years experience taking a product, feature, or experience to market (e.g., design, addressing product market fit, and launch, internal tool/framework).
  • 6+ years experience improving product metrics for a product, feature, or experience in a market (e.g., growing customer base, expanding customer usage, avoiding customer churn).
  • 6+ years experience disrupting a market for a product, feature, or experience (e.g., competitive disruption, taking the place of an established competing product).
  • Experience taking on ambiguous, high-stakes work and driving it from strategy through execution across organizations.  
  • Experience leading large-scale cloud infrastructure, capacity planning, or distributed systems work, with grasp of hyperscale service delivery.  
  • AI fluency, including using AI agents, automation, and prototyping to speed up analysis, decisions, and product work.  
  • Experience using telemetry, demand signals, and operational data to guide platform and investment decisions.  
  • Systems-level problem solving and clear communication, with the ability to influence senior leaders and align stakeholders across organizations. 
#M365Core, #M365CorePlatform, #M365FleetCapacity
